title: Spring constant calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates spring constant k = 40mg/l from force equilibrium on piston I or II using initial spring extension.

title: Final gas pressure
description: Essential: Correctly determines final gas pressure p₂ = p₀ + 3mg/S, matching initial pressure due to unchanged force balance.

title: Final gas temperature
description: Essential: Correctly calculates final temperature T₂ = (4/3)T₀ using isobaric process relation with volume change.

title: Force balance setup
description: Important: Sets up proper force equilibrium equations for both pistons, accounting for gas pressure, atmospheric pressure, spring force, and weights.

title: Volume calculation
description: Important: Correctly computes initial and final gas volumes using given geometry and piston positions.

title: Process identification
description: Important: Recognizes the heating process as isobaric since force balance remains unchanged until piston II reaches junction.

title: Spring length determination
description: Optional: Notes that final spring length equals 1.1l when piston II reaches junction, maintaining same extension.

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for spring force or pressure forces in equilibrium equations.

title: Wrong process assumption
description: Pitfall: Assumes adiabatic or isothermal process instead of isobaric for the heating.

title: Area confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong piston areas when calculating forces or volumes (mixing up 2S and S).
